shadow_archer: A faceless hunter's shadow. Only the bow is sharply visible.
dungeon_overseer: A huge jailer with iron chains wound around his body.
apprentice_doll: A wooden doll with brass joints wearing scraps of a student's uniform. A course enrollment number is engraved on its forehead.
gate_statue: A shield-bearing stone statue that stood beside the academy's main gate. Its entire body is cracked.
clockwork_mice: Palm-sized brass mice spilled from the laboratory.
ashen_student: Three students reduced to ash, entangled together at a single desk.
alarm_orb: A crystal sphere on a cracked pedestal. It fires a beam at intruders.
wandering_lamp: An enchanted lamp wandering the corridors. A faint face is reflected where its ember should be.
senior_assistant: A tall undead figure entangled in dozens of layers of academic gowns. It holds a pointer.
magic_enforcer: A large academy security doll. One of its arms is a hammer.
raging_lecturer: An instructor doll tall enough to touch the classroom ceiling. It carries exactly three chalkboards on its back and gives an endless lecture.
biting_tome: A thick book with teeth growing from its leather cover.
bleeding_ink: Spilled ink that has risen to human height. Letters float inside it.
script_moths: A swarm of gray moths with writing on their wings.
stitched_reader: A librarian's ghost with its mouth stitched shut with thread. It holds open a forbidden book.
quill_archer: A gaunt scribe hanging from a bookshelf ladder. It throws iron quills.
sealing_candelabra: A silver candlestick once used to seal forbidden books. Its candle flames enfold other enemies.
ink_knight: An old imperial knight redrawn in ink. Its outlines continuously bleed and blur.
tome_librarian: A librarian seated atop a ceiling-high pile of books. An open book occupies the place of its face.
sewer_rats: Dozens of hairless rats rolling together as one mass.
tangled_refugees: Several refugees fused together along with their tied bundles of belongings.
rusted_shieldman: A walking ghost consisting only of imperial guard armor. It carries a tower shield.
imperial_crossbow: A skeletal crossbowman with traces of imperial guard heraldry.
nameless_gravekeeper: A gravekeeper's ghost holding an extinguished lantern, with many name tags hanging around its neck.
sewer_spore_sac: A moldy sac hanging from the ceiling. Rats spill out when it bursts.
standard_bearer: A standard-bearer's ghost holding a torn imperial flag.
chained_executioner: An executioner whose two hands are chained to an axe.
familiar_face: An undead figure whose face looks different to each viewer, resembling someone that viewer has lost.
tangled_beast: Several primordial beasts entangled into one body. It has exactly twelve legs.
hands_below: Hands reaching endlessly upward from the floor.
bronze_souls: Ancient warriors wearing bronze armor. Elf and human helmets are intermingled.
ashen_chorus: Dozens of faces embedded in a wall, with only their mouths remaining, singing.
extinguished_priest: A ghost in bloodstained priestly robes, carrying a cracked chalice.
thousand_names: A giant ghost with names engraved all over its body.
abyss_knight: Empty black plate armor belonging to no known nation.
summoners_remnant: Several magicians who once formed a ritual circle, hardened together into one body. Their mouths are still calling something.
two_flag_soldier: A soldier with halves of armor from two factions fused together. It holds the two flags overlapped.
conscript_swarm: Several conscripts wearing ill-fitting helmets, all gripping one shared spear.
rusty_catapult: Soldiers entangled in a wooden catapult frame pull its ropes.
boiling_oil_pot: A pot used to pour oil from the castle wall. It is still boiling.
civil_war_commander: A knight holding a shield with two overpainted coats of arms, no longer knowing which side it belonged to.
siege_tower_remnant: A siege tower with only three wheels remaining. Soldiers hang from every level.
throne_of_division: Several undead nobles wearing different crowns fused together on a single throne. Every mouth proclaims a different edict.
iron_helm_warrior: A warrior with a crude iron helmet and leather armor. The sword blade is chipped.
sacrificed_attendants: Attendants buried with their king, their wrists tied to one another with cords.
sling_tribesman: A tribal warrior whirling a stone in a leather sling.
tomb_priest: A priest holding a jar of ritual wine, with red earth smeared on the face.
iron_chariot: An iron-wheeled chariot pulled by horse bones. Blades are fixed to the wheel axles.
kings_hawk: A hawk with a wingspan greater than a person's height. A royal ring remains around its ankle.
iron_coffin_king: The first king has risen together with his iron-woven coffin. He holds the coffin lid as a shield.
bronze_shieldman: A defender carrying a round bronze shield with green corrosion along its rim.
reed_boat_rowers: Rowers who sank together with their reed boat. They swing oars as weapons.
two_blood_wanderer: A wanderer whose features combine two peoples in equal parts. It died nameless on the road between two villages.
horned_diviner: A diviner with small horns, casting animal bones for divination.
bronze_colossus: A bronze colossus that stood before a temple. Molten bronze flows through its cracks.
exiled_elf_archer: An elven chief archer driven from the forest by humans. Ash clings to the bow stave instead of leaves.
bronze_altar: People offered to a bronze altar have become one with the altar. Its fire has not yet gone out.
sabertooth: A large cat with canine teeth extending below its lower jaw.
giant_beetles: Shield-sized beetles whose shells collide noisily.
stone_knife_shaman: A shaman holding a stone knife and a bone necklace, using the first flame of bloodline magic.
swamp_leeches: Hundreds of leeches clustered together from the swamp floor.
mammoth_wraith: A huge hairy beast with moss on its tusks.
cave_painting_hunter: A hunter drawn on a cave wall has walked out of it. Its body consists of ochre-colored lines.
fallen_guardian: The bones of a huge winged beast. Moss covers the wing bones and a faint light leaks from empty eye sockets. Its identity is unknown.
molten_crowd: A mass of humans, beasts and objects half melted and fused together.
voice_only: A bodiless wandering whisper. Approaching it sounds as if it is calling one's own name.
echo_of_bottom: A huge shadow made from all the screams that have fallen into the abyss, sounding together as one voice. Its shape constantly changes.
frozen_mercenary: A mercenary moves inside frost-hardened armor, still remembering the contract.
blizzard_wolves: Wolves moving as one pack through a blizzard.
ice_crossbowman: A shooter within ice, with only the crossbow sharply visible.
ice_centurion: A centurion half buried in ice, commanding subordinates.
frost_contractor: An entire mercenary company bound to one frozen sheet of contract paper.
thorn_pilgrim: A pilgrim walking toward the holy site while wrapped in thorny vines.
rotten_censer: An old censer burning musty-smelling incense.
shrine_crows: Black crows descending from the holy site's roof.
kneeling_paladin: A paladin frozen rigid while kneeling.
corroded_reliquary: A reliquary pierced through by thorny vines.
waterlogged_sailor: An undead sailor swollen by water, almost ready to burst.
net_fisher: A fisher's ghost holding a net and a harpoon.
barnacle_shell: A hard shell densely covered with barnacles.
wreck_boatswain: A boatswain calling sailors from the deck of a shipwreck.
sunken_bell: A rusty bell ringing from beneath the sea.
tangled_riders: An undead horse and rider entangled into a single mass.
wild_dog_wraiths: A pack of wild-dog wraiths roaming the steppe.
wind_shamaness: A wind shaman's ghost adorned with feathers.
old_khan_rider: The ghost of a rider who once followed the old khan.
three_head_warhorse: The horses of three tribes fused into one body; the source name specifies three heads.
snow_leopard_wraith: A snow leopard's wraith approaching silently through the snow.
ice_tomb_hunter: A hunter risen from an ice tomb.
hands_in_snow: Hands reaching out from within the snow.
ice_mane_leopard: A giant snow leopard whose mane has frozen into ice.
starving_of_the_pass: Caravan people who froze to death at the mountain pass, clustered together as one.
ash_zealot: A worshipper's ghost praying while holding embers.
lava_shell_beast: A beast whose shell is made of solidified lava.
ember_bats: A swarm of bats flying toward the viewer while shedding sparks.
obsidian_priest: A priest's ghost holding an obsidian dagger.
burning_bloodline: Candidates for the priesthood who died during the bloodline trial.
